test.description: Compare debug_traceTransaction a JavaScript tracer returning call context and opcode counts at a verified recent common nonempty block.

params.tracer: {counts: {}, step: function(log) { var op = log.op.toString(); this.counts[op] = (this.counts[op] || 0) + 1; }, fault: function(log, db) {}, result: function(ctx, db) { return {type: ctx.type, from: toHex(ctx.from), to: toHex(ctx.to), gasUsed: ctx.gasUsed, output: toHex(ctx.output), counts: this.counts}; }}
